answer: Every identity posts a 70-credit basalt bond and files its behavior fingerprint at a ledge. Each epoch a beacon draws a random filer to replay ten actions: over 5% off burns the bond; a false flag burns the auditor's. A rented-fingerprint ring fails: a borrowed print bears the lender's ledge mark. The k-th fake pays 42+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,039,000 and lock 70,000, vs a 40,000 pool. An honest filer pays 42 once.
